_about: Reviewed exceptions to the licence policy in docs/security/LICENCES.md. Each entry names the ecosystem, the package and the licence exactly as LICENCES.json records it, and says why it is acceptable. A change of licence upstream stops the entry matching, so the package is reviewed again. scripts/licence_check.py fails on an entry that no longer matches a package.

exceptions.reason: glibc build. Prebuilt libvips for sharp, which next uses for image optimisation. It is a separate shared library (libvips-cpp.so) that sharp's native addon loads at run time: checked with ldd on sharp-linux-x64, which links it dynamically from this package. It is the unmodified npm build and can be swapped for another libvips, which is the LGPL-3.0 combined-work case (section 4). The licence text and notice must travel with any image we hand to someone else.

package.json declares no licence, but the LICENSE file in the published 2.0.0 package is the MIT licence text (checked in node_modules). Arrives through expo's command-line tool (@expo/cli via @expo/rudder-sdk-node), not app code.

The PostgreSQL driver, required by langgraph-checkpoint-postgres. A Python library installed from PyPI as its own unmodified package (pinned by hash in requirements.lock) and imported at run time; nothing from it is copied, vendored or changed in this repository, and it can be replaced with a modified version by reinstalling the package. That is the LGPL-3.0 combined-work case (section 4). The licence text and notice must travel with any image we hand to someone else.
